original.reason: It provides no proof of the theorem.

judgment.reason: The normalization claim is unproved and generally false: dividing by a gcd divisible by 2015 changes the relevant 2015-adic valuations. A periodicity argument could establish that this gcd is coprime to 2015, but it is absent.
It incorrectly asserts without proof that division by g preserves maximal 2015-powers. This requires first proving 2015 does not divide g.
The statement that dividing by g does not change the 2015-adic valuation is false unless 2015 is coprime to g, which is not established.
It has the same material gap: multiplication by g can affect the maximal power of 2015 unless gcd(g,2015)=1, and that necessary fact is not proved.
